ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/shadow) to 30% high-intensity (white/mottling) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to the distal upper regions of both lobes. The left distal tip features a dense, high-frequency mottling of dark pixels on a white background. The right distal tip exhibits larger, isolated low-intensity circular blobs on a continuous high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 58 degrees and a narrow bounding-box width at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge; includes sharp peaks and shallow valleys ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in vertical amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, with a distinct convex sweep along the lower leading edge boundary visible above the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white circular ring structures (approx. 10-12 clusters) primarily located in the lower-medial low-intensity (black) zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of at least four distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, oriented at roughly 45-degree angles relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss/serration along the outer trailing edges and multiple circular healed rosette scars suggesting previous barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetrical distribution of pigmentation where the left lobe tip shows a significantly higher density of dark pixel 'speckling' compared to the right lobe tip.
